execution.reuse: Run the frozen v1 diagnose function body with a private globals dictionary binding v2 authentication, source_context and diagnostic ID; never modify v1 globals or sources. All v1 arithmetic, controls, original-input reference capture, gates, dispatch restrictions and final input/review reauthentication remain intact.
execution.evidence: command.log, validation.json, unchanged v1 diagnostic artifacts and v2 result.json with selected_L9_evidence, native_stage_dispatches and contract binding. Require matching v1 dispatch and guarded native-stage sequences, and unchanged repository origins and contract before and after execution. Historical L10 is recorded as source-incompatible read-only evidence, never an execution parent.
execution.failure: Reject existing outputs, symlinks, missing fresh names and paths outside the direct bounded build prefix before validation or dispatch. Create the directory exclusively. Log and propagate validation/execution failures; never publish a success result on failure.

branch_definitions.inherited: L9 output / L10 input complete I/Z/H coordinate 62; nearest-Q24 original input
branch_definitions.o: L10 S11 O contribution coordinate 62; original binary64 mapped FP16 RNE
branch_definitions.down: L10 S17 down contribution coordinate 62; original binary64 mapped FP16 RNE
branch_definitions.scratch: L10 S12 complete I/Z/H coordinate 62; nearest-Q24 original residual
branch_definitions.S12: exact Q24 input + FP16 S11; H is the FP16 observation, not a new state seed
branch_definitions.inherited_native: change incoming coordinate 62 then recompute native L10, including MLP
branch_definitions.mapped62: exogenous nearest-Q24 original L10 output at coordinate 62 only
branch_definitions.mapped_all: exogenous nearest-Q24 original L10 output at all 896 coordinates

authentication: Reuse current entry.authenticate without weakening source/operand/state/KV/lineage gates. Authenticate every selected L9 input, source, artifact, validation and policy binding. Consume only its frozen actual L9 I/Z/H parent after matching authenticated L9 arrays/output, L10 incoming parent, L10 arrays and gate reports. All original-input independent global references remain untouched. Historical L10 is preserved read-only and tested as source-incompatible, never rebound or used as a current execution input.
validation: Compile the actual v2 candidate and focused test files in memory. Record every loaded repository module origin, including tests.test_q24_s16_toward_zero_l3_l8_v1, without collecting that accepted suite. Run only the focused unittest suite once, with native dispatch and native stages forbidden; execution wiring uses synthetic delegates only. Full entry authentication runs read-only once in the suite. --check writes no build evidence and cannot execute controls. --out runs this same validation once before the fixed execution, saving its record in the fresh directory. Independent Host Reviewer reproduction is required.

thresholds.S0_S17: Unchanged finite AND (abs_error <= 0.125 OR (relative_error < 0.001 AND ordered_FP16_ULP <= 1)); denominator max(abs(reference), 2^-14); independent same-actual-operand local reference.
thresholds.trajectory: Original FP16 trajectory diagnostics and independently propagated original-input binary64 reference are preserved, never reseeded from the selected actual parent.

claim_boundary: Versioned software producer-cone runtime surface and zero-dispatch preflight, not a new numerical result or independent native execution authorization. Top-level zero invocation counts describe --check; execution counts apply only to the separately selected --out run. Reuse v1 plan, branch cuts and original reference capture unchanged. Q24 residual state is wider than FP16; native G128 asymmetric INT4 weights, GEMM ordering, no qzero plus-one, FP16 scales/operator boundaries/KV and S16 RTZ remain unchanged. No accepted L0-L8 replay, new-token, strict-FP16-state W4A16 or full-model PASS; no RTL, hardware, GPU, FPGA, simulation, synthesis, PPA, precision/reference/configuration/framework/Host/model/budget/ACE2 changes.
